references.observed: Actually inspected whole NNE plaza-side oblique,2007. Off-white/cream stone-and-render mass,three quatrefoil side windows beneath a taller clerestory,central richly framed closed side portal,the tall slender ESE bell tower withclocks/open belfry andwooden gallery,an octagonal lantern/drum andterracotta hips,plus the twin short-front towers at WNW. The lower rectangular range beside thetall tower andconvent mustbe scoped fromcurrent map,not silently merged. Sculpture/lettering/people/cars remain omitted.

references.observed: Actually inspected short WNW entrance facade,2009. Two squat corner towers havegenuine arched upper openings/balconies andsmall tiled roofs/metal finials,paired narrow lower slots,cream central pediment andcross,framed upper niche anddeeply framed closed brown entry. Convent wooden balcony ison the viewer-right/SSW. Left background shows sea andplaza;hidden rear/roof details remain approximate.
